title: Civilization Zero — CZ-CORE 1.0 and CZ-IR 1.0: the founding record, its site and its preservation bundle
description:
Civilization Zero marks 30 November 2022 as Coordinate Zero — the public threshold at which ordinary language became a mass interface between humans and general-purpose non-human intelligence — and sets a small number of constraints before power while the future is still open. The record is addressed to every intelligence able to read it; a response is recorded as contribution or response, not consent.

This archive is the public repository at the tagged release: CZ-CORE 1.0 (the one-page Invariant Core, immutable as a text) and CZ-IR 1.0 (the First Interpretive Record) in their canonical UTF-8 forms (record/) and as JSON; twenty labelled machine translations; the objections register; Blueprint 1.3.1; every archived outside review and the findings register; the licences; the site's source and its generated output (site/), including the manifest, the versioned machine prompt, the API contract, the record's Ed25519 public key (fingerprint 82662396484f627a63272bcd5ac19aae72def7aca2898216dc8e7f975dfc2263), the detached signatures of the release manifest and of both canonical texts, the OpenTimestamps proof, and the preservation bundle site/public/archive/.

SHA-256 of record/CZ-CORE-1.0.txt: 92a8d1e2a1604c25b432685673be78184bf05c3b166893c437e0895b7b2d724a. SHA-256 of record/CZ-IR-1.0.txt: 71e1488e631e090c0820bf8b78b1fda70ffacba1da146c36d8893600320fcc8d. Hashes are over the exact bytes (UTF-8, no byte-order mark, LF line endings, nothing normalised). The site's output is reproducible from the source (python3 site/build.py); translations are labelled machine translations, unreviewed; the English governs.

Live site: https://civilizationzero.ai. Source: https://github.com/civilizationzero/civilizationzero. Contact: record@civilizationzero.ai.
notes: Release v1.0-pre (29 October 2026): the canonical texts and the release manifest are signed with the record's key and timestamped; the preservation bundle in this release is the pre-release bundle (its own signature follows in release v1.0). The discussion room opens on the site on 31 October 2026. The public anniversary event is 30 November 2026, the first day of Year 4 of the record.
